notes: Rules are checked in order; the first match wins. Actions are shown in the sheet only. Nothing is sent automatically. Timing targets are for Fernstone to set.

rules.name: no_data
rules.action: No scraped data. Call to qualify: confirm what the business does, headcount, vehicles, locations and when coverage renews. Do not judge fit yet.

rules.name: low_confidence
rules.action: Evidence is thin, so the score is provisional. Call to qualify using the discovery questions before deciding priority.

rules.name: high
rules.action: Strong fit. Call as soon as possible and open with the icebreaker, then the discovery questions.

rules.name: medium
rules.action: Possible fit. Add to the follow-up list. After rep review, send the follow-up email and try a call.

rules.name: low
rules.action: Likely not a fit. Rep reviews, then nurture or disqualify. No brief generated.
